paper.title: Optimizing Wind Farms Layouts for Maximum Energy Production Using Probabilistic Inference: Benchmarking Reveals Superior Computational Efficiency and Scalability

paper_linked_public_source.name: SRMP
paper_linked_public_source.author: Vladimir Kolmogorov
paper_linked_public_source.target_use: paper uses this source with TRWS_weighting=1, 5000 triplet clusters, one thread and a one-hour cutoff
audited_compatibility_changes: add an empty virtual FactorType destructor because Energy deletes derived factor types through the base pointer; required by ASAN and changes no arithmetic
project-owned forwarding subclass supplies the legacy SharedPairwiseFactorType flags overload without changing upstream methods

use source-supported fixed insertion ordering sort_flag=-1 because the author order is unavailable and v1.01 automatic equal-key factor sorting does not terminate safely for the dense triplet graph on the target AArch64 toolchain

unavailable_triplet_source.name: GEMPLP mplp_ver2
unavailable_triplet_source.target_boundary: the paper used an unpublished modified version; neither the modification nor the resulting cluster lists are public

author_manuscript_pdf.use: visual equation/table/figure cross-check only; local primary PDF remains the identity authority

predecessor_thesis.use: confirms the formulation and role grids but does not supply beta, target cluster generator, exact rounding or numerical WR-36

supporting_assets.nrel_curve_lineage: FLORIS v2.4 NREL-5MW CP/CT arrays already source-audited and versioned by the platform T81 package

paper_native_method.objective: minimize X^T W X subject to binary X and sum(X)=K
paper_native_method.mrf_energy: X^T W X + beta*(sum(X)-K)^2, with the constant beta*K^2 omitted inside SRMP
paper_native_method.inference: official sequential TRW-S through SRMP v1.01 with TRWS_weighting=1
paper_native_method.triplets: 5000 consistency triplets for 100/400-cell roles and no triplets for 2500-cell roles
paper_native_method.posterior_decoder: paper states a simple rounding scheme for 2500 cells but does not publish it
paper_native_method.stopping: one-hour cutoff; official source maximum 10000 iterations and epsilon 1e-8

historical.farm: 2 km by 2 km, 10 by 10 cells, 200 m spacing

realistic.turbine: NREL 5 MW, R=63 m, H=90 m, source curve
realistic.spacing: strictly at least 5R=315 m; explicit pair conflicts are needed only at 2500 cells

wind.WR-36: 36 directions by 8/12/17 m/s; target provides probabilities only as a figure

paper_native_problems.wake: Jensen top-hat, alpha=0.1 and root-sum-square multiple deficits

paper_protocol.derivation: 4 historical plus two winds times (10 grid100 + 25 grid400 + 19 grid2500)
paper_protocol.repeat_semantics: deterministic method and no independent repeat count; execute each role once

missing_information: author wrapper, executable environment, exact ordering and hardware state
modified GEMPLP cluster generator, 5000-cluster lists and cluster-generation parameters
exact NREL CP/CT/power table revision consumed by the authors
raw layouts, message histories and random/order state
conflicts_and_completions: Use the platform's versioned Turner-lineage Figure digitization for WR-36 and identify it as a declared same-benchmark completion.
Use the versioned FLORIS-v2.4 NREL-5MW CP/CT curve lineage already audited in T81; do not claim the authors' exact numerical table.
Set beta to 1.01 times the maximum symmetric interaction row sum so a one-cell cardinality deviation is more expensive than any one-cell wake marginal.
Set each 2500-cell spacing conflict cost to beta*(4*K+4), then enforce exact K and 5R feasibility by deterministic marginal-cost repair.
Score deterministic triplet candidates from each node's 24 strongest interaction/conflict neighbors, rank unique triangles by summed pair score and fill lexicographically to exactly 5000.
Report both raw SRMP cardinality and repaired cardinality; apply deterministic feasible one-swap improvement after repair.
Use fixed insertion ordering sort_flag=-1 for the source/toolchain reason recorded above; never represent it as the unavailable author order.

hpc.backend: pure C++20 CPU-HPC plus official GPL SRMP C++ source

analysis.triplet_candidate_scoring: parallel strongest-neighbor rows followed by deterministic global ranking
analysis.trws: ordered forward/backward message dependence; sequential within one role to preserve official semantics
analysis.posterior_aep: O(Nwind*K^2), independent wind-target tasks with fixed-index reduction
analysis.outer_campaign: 112 independent deterministic roles scheduled across all visible cores; one inner worker per role

hpc.memory: no-triplet 2500-cell roles use SharedPairwiseFactorType; triplet roles use source-native general factors because upstream shared factors do not implement MPLP messages
hpc.required_invariant: one-worker and all-worker interaction, posterior AEP, layout and scientific hash identity

physical_fes_definition: one complete posterior nonlinear AEP evaluation of one complete layout; matrix construction, triplet scoring, message sweeps and repair are separate work
claim_boundary: Flexible equation/source-level academic reproduction of the target message-passing method and all 112 paper algorithm/problem roles; not the unavailable modified GEMPLP generator, author beta/order/wrapper, exact layout/numerical/timing replay or first parallelization claim.
